name: Negative: Vague description triggers clarification request
objective: Validate that Agentforce seeks clarification when user provides a vague issue description.
precondition: Portal user logged in, Agentforce chat open.

steps.expectedResult: Agent asks for more detail about the issue

executionResult.agentResponse: I understand something is not working. Could you please describe your issue in more detail? The more information you provide, the better I can help you select the right category and assist you with your request. If you would like to create an incident, let me know and I will guide you through the process.
